# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native timed match-3 game called **Mutant Homestead: Pressure Harvest**. Use a 6x8 board, adjacent swaps by tap/tap or drag, match horizontal or vertical runs of 3+, reverse invalid swaps, clear matches, collapse downward, refill from above, resolve cascades, score 100 per tile with 4-match x2, 5+ x3, and +25% per cascade chain, and end after 60 seconds with tap-to-restart.

Presentation: an original X-team-inspired comic farm world, not licensed characters. The focal identity is a cozy farmer in a mutant pressure greenhouse. Use indigo/gold/cream/leaf/danger palette, procedural crop icons, comic panel outlines, pressure-dome HUD, chain harvest callouts, and mobile-readable UI.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Timed mobile-friendly match-3 arcade puzzle.
- objective: Swap adjacent tiles to create horizontal or vertical runs of three or more before a 60 second timer expires.
- input model: Canvas pointer input; tap one cell then an adjacent cell, or drag from one cell to an adjacent cell; tap after game over restarts.
- core loop: Initialize a 6x8 grid with no starting matches, accept adjacent swaps, reject non-matching swaps by swapping back, clear matches, score them, collapse columns downward, spawn new tiles from above, resolve cascades, continue until timer reaches zero.
- fail/friction state: Invalid swaps are reverted with feedback; final fail state occurs when the countdown reaches zero and an overlay asks the player to tap to restart.

## Protected mechanics
- 6 columns by 8 rows grid.
- 60 second countdown pressure window.
- Adjacent-only swap by tap/tap or drag.
- Horizontal/vertical match detection for runs of 3+.
- Invalid swap reversal.
- Downward gravity collapse and top refill.
- Cascade resolution after each refill.
- Score formula: 100 per matched tile, 4-match x2, 5+ x3, cascade multiplier +25% per additional chain.
- RequestAnimationFrame loop and tap-to-restart failure flow.

## Remixed target
A deterministic, comic-book-action, X-team-inspired but original “mutant homestead” match-3 game: a cozy farmer stabilizes glowing mutant crops inside a pressure dome. The mechanics remain a timed adjacent-swap match-3 loop; the meaning, focal art, HUD, tile language, scene, feedback, and audio are rebuilt around high-pressure farmyard harvest containment.
